title: Products Preserve Coordinate Independence
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $q$ and $r$ be real-valued functions on the sign cube that are each unchanged when coordinate $i$ is changed. Then their pointwise product $x\mapsto q(x)r(x)$ is unchanged when coordinate $i$ is changed.
